props.gloss_en: the mishna: one does not read the Megilla until sunrise (and the mishna adds: if done from daybreak, it is valid)
from where? the verse says 'and these days are remembered and done' (Esther 9:28) -- by day, yes; at night, no
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: a person must read the Megilla at night and repeat it by day
when the mishna teaches [not until sunrise], it is speaking of the day [reading]

supports.gloss_en: מנלן? דאמר קרא: והימים האלה נזכרים ונעשים -- ביום אין, בלילה לא: the source of the mishna's 'not until sunrise'

challenges.gloss_en: לימא תיהוי תיובתא דרבי יהושע בן לוי -- from the mishna's clause (one reads only by day; ביום אין בלילה לא), RYbL's 'one must read it at night' would be refuted

answered_by.gloss_en: כי קתני -- אדיום: the mishna's clause addresses the day reading (= p_matnitin_adyom); it says nothing against a night reading
